audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows of the level chart contradict the matchup's own explanations: win[0]/phases[0] said Skill while whys[0] says hit him before he hits 2; win[2] said Sion while whys[2] says both patterns cancel; win[5] said Sion while whys[5] says his Sheen spike one-shots your shield; win[6] said Sion while whys[6] says the win conditions split.
audit.why: The packet chart (Sion, Sion, Skill, Skill, Skill, Nasus, Skill) agrees with every one of those explanations. The rows were the error, not the prose.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 5 and 6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group, ratings adjusted on 0 and 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike rested on a claim that Unstoppable Onslaught's ramping speed outruns Wither's slow.
audit.why: Nothing in Riot's description supports a speed-versus-slow race, and the mirror audit deliberately refused to assert Sion's charge ignores CC. What IS verifiable is range: R launches from 7500 units, Wither only reaches 700, so the charge is committed long before he can age you.
audit.corrected: Spike and mid now argue from the 7500-vs-700 range gap and Wither's 15s rank-1 cooldown instead of an unverified speed claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lifesteal was attributed to Fury of the Sands twice ('his R's lifesteal'), and the page never told an HP-stacking Sion that Nasus's ultimate is exactly the tool that beats bulk.
audit.why: Soul Eater (P) is the lifesteal. Fury of the Sands (120/100/80s) grants him health, attack range, armour and MR while burning nearby enemies for a share of their maximum health — against a Heartsteel Sion that scales with your own HP bar, and armour alone does not answer it.
audit.corrected: late, spikes[3] and wants.foe[2] now name Fury of the Sands and its max-health burn.

audit.why: Plated Steelcaps and anti-heal are already on the report; the added max-health note in late keeps the player from over-buying pure resists.

edits.before: Charged Q from brush/fog is a half-HP knockup. Only take the trade when Nasus's Wither is down.
edits.after: Charged Q from brush or fog is a half-HP knockup, and Wither is a 15s cooldown at rank 1 — trade on it.

edits.before: Unstoppable Onslaught outruns the Wither slow at launch — fire R after he activates Wither to close before the speed penalty fully bites.
edits.after: Unstoppable Onslaught launches from 7500 range, far outside his 700-range Wither — fire it once he has spent the slow and he cannot answer.

edits.before: Unstoppable Onslaught closes the gap on a Wither-slowed Sion — the R speed is too fast for Wither to fully negate, giving a clean all-in window.
edits.after: Unstoppable Onslaught launches from 7500 range, well outside Wither's 700 — bait the slow (15s at rank 1), then charge and he has no escape.

edits.before: At 400+ stacks Nasus's Q deletes your W-shield in one proc and his R's lifesteal sustains through your zombie passive — respect the late game.
edits.after: At 400+ stacks Siphoning Strike deletes Soul Furnace in one proc, and Fury of the Sands burns max HP — your HP stack is not armour against it.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 6 are a patience game where whoever wastes a cooldown first loses the trade. Your W-shield eats one empowered Q proc but not two consecutive ones, so never let him stack Wither and then walk into a brawl — that combination will delete your shield and leave you slowed in melee range. When Wither is on cooldown, run the full pattern: E-slow to close distance, then let the Q channel complete for the knockup; his 0-mobility kit has no answer once you're on top of him. At level 6 your Unstoppable Onslaught is the counter to Wither — R's speed buildup outruns Wither's slow for the first second of travel, meaning you can fire R from edge of screen and close before the speed penalty fully kicks in. Use it after he Withers you to bait out the cooldown, then immediately E into a charged Q for a kill attempt.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 6 are a patience game where whoever wastes a cooldown first loses the trade. Your W-shield eats one empowered Q proc but not two consecutive ones, so never let him land Wither and then walk into a brawl — that combination will delete your shield and leave you slowed in melee range. When Wither is on cooldown, run the full pattern: E-slow to close distance, then let the Q channel complete for the knockup; his zero-mobility kit has no answer once you're on top of him. At level 6 Unstoppable Onslaught answers Wither by range, not by speed: you launch from 7500 units and Wither only reaches 700, so the charge is committed before he can age you. Bait the 15-second cooldown first, then immediately E into a charged Q for the kill attempt.

edits.before: Two items in, Nasus becomes a genuine problem: 400+ Q stacks delete your W-shield in one proc, his R's lifesteal sustains through your zombie passive, and his size makes your charged Q easier to interrupt by stepping behind minions. Your win condition from here is not to duel him straight — it is to use your zombie passive to zone him off objectives while your team collapses, and to force the fight before his R is up. Your Unstoppable Onslaught still threatens him in the open but he simply outruns you in sustained damage at high stacks. Respect the math: a fed Nasus with 500 stacks and Sheen deletes Sion, but a Sion who banked a lead in the stack-denial window and is roaming with R has already won the game before that scaling matters.
edits.after: Two items in, Nasus becomes a genuine problem: 400+ Q stacks delete your W-shield in one proc, Fury of the Sands burns a share of your maximum health and hands him bonus armour and MR, and Soul Eater's lifesteal refills him mid-brawl. Your win condition from here is not to duel him straight — it is to use your zombie passive to zone him off objectives while your team collapses, and to force the fight before his R is up (120s at rank 1). Unstoppable Onslaught still threatens him in the open, but he out-sustains you at high stacks. Because his ultimate scales off your health bar, raw resists do not save you — a lead banked in the stack-denial window does.

edits.before: Hit his R at 6 to lifesteal through your zombie passive and deny the free damage window
edits.after: Pop Fury of the Sands to burn a share of your max HP and out-armour your stacked bulk
